title: Repository skeleton, frozen locks, module boundaries, CI pipeline
commit_line: chore(repo): FND-01 skeleton, locks, boundaries, CI (ARCH-03-001..004, ARCH-01-001, TECH-00-001..003)

ci_interpretation.note: Orchestrator-approved: this repository has no git remote and no CI runner. The PR pipeline is therefore executed natively by ci/run.sh, which mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml step-for-step (same commands, same order). Acceptance 'CI green' = one full ci/run.sh run exiting 0. .github/workflows/ci.yml remains the canonical pipeline for a future remote runner; the node job pins the exact linux/amd64 image digest.
ci_interpretation.toolchain_resolution: ci/run.sh owns its toolchain and makes no ambient-PATH assumptions: it pins NODE_HOME=$HOME/.local/node/node-v24.21.0-linux-x64 (self-healing: downloads the official linux-x64 tarball to that exact path if missing), prepends $NODE_HOME/bin to PATH, sets COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0, ensures the corepack pnpm shim exists in $NODE_HOME/bin, and resolves uv from ~/.pyenv/versions/*/bin/uv (or ~/.local/bin/uv) when the ambient PATH has no uv. This is required because fresh shells shadow the pinned toolchain: the orchestrator shell has pi-node v22.23.1 first on PATH (~/.local/share/pi-node/...), a login shell falls back to /usr/bin/node v20.18.1, and uv is a pyenv shim absent from non-interactive PATHs.
clean_shell_commands: env -i HOME=$HOME USER=$USER TERM=$TERM bash -lc 'cd /home/srcds/dev/milpbookLM && bash ci/run.sh'
env PATH=$HOME/.local/share/pi-node/node-v22.23.1-linux-x64/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$HOME USER=$USER bash -c 'cd /home/srcds/dev/milpbookLM && bash ci/run.sh'
